scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:docs
scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter @litopis/core build && bun run --filter @litopis/dom build && bun run --filter @litopis/elements build && bun run --filter @litopis/react build && bun run --filter @litopis/vue build && bun run --filter @litopis/solid build && bun run --filter @litopis/svelte build
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.pack:check: node scripts/check-package-manifests.mjs && for package in packages/*; do publint "$package"; done
scripts.release: bun run check:release && bun run publish
scripts.check:release: bun run check:release:base && bun run test:browser
scripts.check:release:base: bun run check && bun run build:docs && bun run test:headless && bun run pack:check && bun run audit
